hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */bots/baron/*.py) touch /tmp/baron-gauntlet-dirty; python3 -m py_compile "$f" || exit 2 ;; esac; }

if [ -f /tmp/baron-gauntlet-dirty ]; then rm -f /tmp/baron-gauntlet-dirty; cd /home/peter/projects/teaPot && timeout 480 .venv/bin/python scripts/mirror_gauntlet.py --bot baron > /tmp/baron-gauntlet-last.log 2>&1; ec=$?; if [ $ec -ne 0 ]; then tail -30 /tmp/baron-gauntlet-last.log; exit 2; fi; fi
